newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIA TO PLAY TWO FRIENDLIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIA TO PLAY TWO FRIENDLIES.

text.p: Bulgaria will play friendly matches against Slovakia and Turkey's Fenerbahce ahead of its World Cup qualifier in April, Bulgarian Football Union officials said on Wednesday.
Bulgaria will play Fenerbahce on February 26 in Istanbul, where Bulgaria's key striker Emil Kostadinov plays, and Slovakia on March 11 in Sofia.
So far in its World Cup group, Bulgaria lost 2-1 to Israel, managed only a meagre 2-1 win over Luxembourg and beat Cyprus 3-1.
Bulgaria's next qualifier in its European group five will be at home against Cyprus on April 4.
Head coach Hristo Bonev, who says new blood is needed in the team, called on Tuesday 33 players from Bulgarian clubs for a game on January 29 in the Bulgarian town of Sandanski.
